name: Burundian law: the acts printed in the Bulletin Officiel du Burundi (amategeko.gov.bi), one folder per act, one file per article
label: Burundi
history_note: BOB issues are used where the PDF has a text layer: the publisher's own born-digital text (about 2010 to early 2024) or, for older issues, the publisher's OCR layer (tagged publisher OCR (known reading errors), unusable pages skipped); scans with no text are left out; acts are held as printed, amendments are not applied to the acts they amend
author: the act itself (kind, number and date as printed in its heading)

citation.note: an article is cited inside its act as "article 12"; files are article-012.md, article-012-bis.md
